lines.en: label day144:
scene roofday
I somehow find myself on the rooftop yet again.
lines.zh: 不知怎么的，我又一次来到了天台。

lines.en: I don’t have anything particular in mind and I’m not really looking for Makoto or Yumi or anyone but...
lines.zh: 我心里没什么特别的事，也不是在找 Makoto 或 Yumi 或任何人，不过……

lines.en: I don’t know, I guess I kind of just wound up here without putting much thought into it.
lines.zh: 我不知道，我想我只是没怎么想就晃到这儿来了。

lines.en: I’m becoming one step closer to the lead in an anime every day.
lines.zh: 我离成为动画主角又近了一步。

lines.en: Ami is going to be so proud.
lines.zh: Ami 一定会很骄傲的。

lines.en: scene black
I begin to pace around the perimeter of the rooftop, trying to figure out whether I’m alone up here or not, but then spot something a little...out of the ordinary.
lines.zh: 我开始沿着天台边缘踱步，想弄清楚上面是不是只有我一个人，但接着发现了有点……不寻常的东西。

lines.en: scene tsuneyointro1
For a brief moment in time, I forget that I’m a teacher and worry about her getting scared of me or something along those lines.
lines.zh: 有那么一瞬间，我忘了自己是老师，还担心她会不会被我吓到之类的。

lines.en: But judging by her stone faced reaction to my blazer and...well the fact that I’m on the roof of the[school], I’m pretty sure she’s able to figure it out.
lines.zh: 不过看她对我的西装外套毫无反应，再加上……嗯，我正站在[school]的天台上，我敢肯定她能猜得出来。

lines.en: The two of us sort of just...stand there staring at each other for, well, an uncomfortably long amount of time.
lines.zh: 我们俩就这么……站在那里盯着对方，时间久得让人不舒服。

lines.en: How should I handle this?
lines.zh: 我该怎么处理这件事？

lines.en: menu:
Keep staring
lines.zh: 继续盯着

lines.en: No reaction...
lines.zh: 毫无反应……

lines.en: menu:
Keep staring...
lines.zh: 继续盯着……

lines.en: scene tsuneyointro2
What the hell is up with this girl?
lines.zh: 这女孩到底怎么回事？

lines.en: menu:
KEEP STARING!
lines.zh: 继续盯着！

lines.en: scene tsuneyointro3
menu:
Omfg
lines.zh: 我的天啊

lines.en: : Jesus Christ, are you really going to just keep staring at me? What’s your deal?
lines.zh: : Jesus Christ，你还真打算就这么一直盯着我？你到底怎么回事？

lines.en: scene tsuneyointro4
And now she’s looking away from me?
lines.zh: 现在她又把视线移开了？

lines.en: What even happened? All I did was stare at her.
lines.zh: 到底发生了什么？我只是盯着她看而已啊。

lines.en: Okay, well, it sounds a little bad when I actually repeat it back to myself, but still.
lines.zh: 好吧，把这句话在心里重复一遍，确实听起来有点糟，但话又说回来。

lines.en: I’ve done much worse to different people and at least gotten reactions out of them.
lines.zh: 我对别人做过更过分的事，至少还能得到点反应。

lines.en: This is torture.
lines.zh: 这简直是折磨。

lines.en: jump hellotsuneyo2
Say hello
lines.zh: 打招呼

lines.en: jump hellotsuneyo
Say hello
lines.zh: 打招呼

lines.en: jump hellotsuneyo
Say hello
lines.zh: 打招呼

lines.en: jump hellotsuneyo
Say hello
lines.zh: 打招呼

lines.en: jump hellotsuneyo
label hellotsuneyo:
: Hey. What are you up to?
lines.zh: : 嘿。你在干什么呢？

lines.en: scene tsuneyointro4
Is she...ignoring me?
lines.zh: 她……在无视我？

lines.en: What the hell did I do wrong?
lines.zh: 我到底做错了什么？

lines.en: jump hellotsuneyo2
label hellotsuneyo2:
: Can you at least tell me your name? That would be a good place to start.
lines.zh: : 至少能告诉我你的名字吧？这是个不错的开始。

lines.en: : Ramen.
lines.zh: : Ramen。

lines.en: : Your name is Ramen?
lines.zh: : 你的名字叫 Ramen？

lines.en: scene tsuneyointro5
The girl closes her eyes and simply nods. I refuse to believe her name is Ramen.
lines.zh: 女孩闭上眼睛，只是点了点头。我拒绝相信她的名字叫 Ramen。

lines.en: It would be one thing to come out and say she doesn’t want to talk to me, but to lie just seconds after meeting? That’s unforgivable.
lines.zh: 直接说不想跟我说话是一回事，可才认识几秒钟就撒谎？这不可原谅。

lines.en: : You know I’m a teacher, right? I can give you detention.
lines.zh: : 你知道我是老师吧？我可以让你留堂。

lines.en: : Is that something you want? Detention? It’s not fun. I can promise you that.
lines.zh: : 你想要那样吗？留堂？一点都不好玩。这点我可以向你保证。

lines.en: You know...maybe I should just head back downstairs.
lines.zh: 你知道吗……也许我该下楼去了。

lines.en: I can tell this meeting isn’t going anywhere and-
lines.zh: 我看得出来这次碰面不会有什么结果，而且——

lines.en: : You came to the ramen shop with a girl before.
lines.zh: : 你之前带着一个女孩来过拉面店。

lines.en: : Ramen shop?
lines.zh: : 拉面店？

lines.en: scene tsuneyointro6
: Tojo Ramen. My family's restaurant. Old District. Thirteen minutes by bus.
lines.zh: : Tojo Ramen。我家的店。老城区。坐公交十三分钟。

lines.en: Thirteen minutes by bus?...
lines.zh: 坐公交十三分钟？……

lines.en: Wait, is she talking about the second half of town?
lines.zh: 等等，她说的是镇子的另一半吗？

lines.en: I vaguely remember going to a ramen shop there with Yumi but...
lines.zh: 我隐约记得和 Yumi 去过那儿的一家拉面店，不过……

lines.en: : Wait a minute, you were the girl behind the counter, weren’t you?
lines.zh: : 等等，你就是当时柜台后面的那个女孩吧？

lines.en: : Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo Tojo? That’s your full name?
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo Tojo？那是你的全名？

lines.en: : Correct.
lines.zh: : 没错。

lines.en: : That sounds like a samurai name.
lines.zh: : 听起来像个武士的名字。

lines.en: : Samurai of flavor.
lines.zh: : 风味的武士。

lines.en: scene tsuneyointro7
: I’m so sorry.
lines.zh: : 非常抱歉。

lines.en: : Thank you for apologizing. That was one of the worst jokes I’ve ever heard.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你道歉。这是我听过的最烂的笑话之一。

lines.en: : Comedy isn’t really my strong suit.
lines.zh: : 喜剧确实不是我的强项。

lines.en: : No, it’s really not...
lines.zh: : 不，真不是……

lines.en: : But on the bright side, whatever dish you made me that night at the restaurant was great.
lines.zh: : 不过往好处想，那晚你在店里给我做的那道菜很好吃。

lines.en: : I’m not normally one to rave about ramen, but I can definitely see myself coming back for that sometime soon.
lines.zh: : 我平时不太会为拉面大惊小怪，但我绝对能想象自己很快会为了它再跑一趟。

lines.en: scene tsuneyointro8
: Thank you.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。

lines.en: : I plan to take over once my father passes, so I am eternally grateful to hear that.
lines.zh: : 我打算在父亲过世后接手，所以听到这些我感激不尽。

lines.en: Eternally grateful?...
lines.zh: 感激不尽？……

lines.en: Why is she being so formal with me?
lines.zh: 她为什么对我这么正式？

lines.en: : You know you can talk a little more casually, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 你知道你可以说得随便一点的，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: scene tsuneyointro9
: Ah-
Oh, shit. I’ve gotten so used to calling the other girls by their first names that I’ve forgotten that isn’t really what most people are accustomed to.
lines.zh: 哦，糟糕。叫其他女孩的名字叫习惯了，我都忘了大多数人其实不习惯这样。

lines.en: I guess Tsuneyo’s family is a little more traditional in nature. I’m honestly not surprised with a name as heavy as ‘Tojo.’
lines.zh: 我猜 Tsuneyo 家里比较传统。想想「Tojo」这么沉重的姓氏，我其实并不意外。

lines.en: : I’m not used to talking informally. I might make a mistake.
lines.zh: : 我不习惯说得不正式。我可能会出错。

lines.en: : What kind of mistake would you even make with something like that?
lines.zh: : 这种事你又能出什么错呢？

lines.en: : Who knows, bro?
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢，老兄？

lines.en: : Did you just call me bro?
lines.zh: : 你刚刚叫我「老兄」？

lines.en: scene tsuneyointro7
: See what I mean?
lines.zh: : 你懂我意思了吧？

lines.en: : Yeah, I get it. You can just stick to your normal way of speaking for now.
lines.zh: : 好，我懂了。你暂时就按你平常的方式说话吧。

lines.en: : Are you okay with me using your first name, though?
lines.zh: : 不过我可以用你的名字吗？

lines.en: scene tsuneyointro6
: Sure. A name is a name. It doesn’t make much difference to me.
lines.zh: : 可以。名字就是名字。对我来说没什么区别。

lines.en: : Cool. So, Tsuneyo-
lines.zh: : 好。那么，Tsuneyo——

lines.en: scene tsuneyointro9
: Ah-
: ...You’re not actually going to have an easy time adjusting to that, are you?
lines.zh: : ……你其实没那么容易适应这个，是吧？

lines.en: scene tsuneyointro10
: No. It appears I am not.
lines.zh: : 是的。看来我确实是。

lines.en: : Well, anyway, would you mind explaining what you’re doing on the roof?
lines.zh: : 那么，不管怎样，你能解释一下你在天台上干什么吗？

lines.en: : You know students aren’t supposed to be up here, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道学生是不该上来的吧？

lines.en: scene tsuneyointro8
: We’re not?
lines.zh: : 我们不该吗？

lines.en: : Nope. It’s grounds for immediate expulsion or something like that.
lines.zh: : 不该。按理说这足以立刻开除之类的。

lines.en: : That sounds serious.
lines.zh: : 听起来很严重。

lines.en: : You say that, but you haven’t moved an inch.
lines.zh: : 你嘴上这么说，可是一步都没动。

lines.en: scene tsuneyointro6
: Are you going to discipline me, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 您要处分我吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : That...
lines.zh: : 那个……

lines.en: I really wish she wouldn’t say things like that out of nowhere.
lines.zh: 我真希望她别突然冒出这种话。

lines.en: I’m suddenly blindsided by an onslaught of malicious thoughts that I need to fight off in order to carry on the conversation.
lines.zh: 我突然被一大堆恶意的念头击中，得拼命把它们压下去才能继续对话。

lines.en: : Discipline isn't really my style. I’m more or less curious about how you made it onto the roof.
lines.zh: : 处分不太符合我的风格。我只是有点好奇你是怎么上天台的。

lines.en: : The same way you did.
lines.zh: : 和你一样。

lines.en: scene tsuneyointro10
: One step at a time...
lines.zh: : 一步一步走上来……

lines.en: : You’re not trying to sound philosophical, are you? Because if so, that was pretty bad.
lines.zh: : 你该不会是想显得很有哲理吧？如果是的话，那可太烂了。

lines.en: scene tsuneyointro11
: Philosophy isn’t a strong suit of mine either.
lines.zh: : 哲学也不是我的强项。

lines.en: : I can tell. But hey, at least you have cooking.
lines.zh: : 看得出来。不过嘿，至少你还有厨艺。

lines.en: scene tsuneyointro5
: That’s right.
lines.zh: : 没错。

lines.en: : I will spend the rest of my life washing pork broth out of my hair.
lines.zh: : 我这辈子都要把猪骨汤从头发里洗掉。

lines.en: : It is not a glamorous life, but it is one that I have accepted.
lines.zh: : 这不是什么光鲜的人生，但这是我已经接受的人生。

lines.en: Huh...
I wonder if this is one of those “I was born into my role and didn’t get to choose it” scenarios that typically arise as plot devices in TV and whatnot.
lines.zh: 我在想，这会不会又是那种「我生来就被安排在某个位置上，没有选择权」的设定，通常在电视剧之类的里当剧情道具用。

lines.en: : Hey, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: scene tsuneyointro9
: Ah-
: How do you feel about taking over for your father?
lines.zh: : 你对接手你父亲的店有什么感觉？

lines.en: scene tsuneyointro3
: I am fine with it.
lines.zh: : 我没意见。

lines.en: : I can not become a stand-up comedian, so this is the only choice I have.
lines.zh: : 我当不成单口喜剧演员，所以这是我唯一的选择。

lines.en: : So your only options in life are ramen and stand-up comedy?
lines.zh: : 所以你这辈子只有拉面和单口喜剧两个选项？

lines.en: : No. Just ramen. Comedy is off the table.
lines.zh: : 不。只有拉面。喜剧不在考虑范围内。

lines.en: : Well if you ever want to expand your horizons or anything, my office is always open.
lines.zh: : 那么，如果你哪天想拓宽一下视野什么的，我的办公室随时开着。

lines.en: Now, I know what you’re thinking.
lines.zh: 现在，我知道你在想什么。

lines.en: Me? Offering up an actual counseling session to a [teenage]girl without any ulterior motives?
lines.zh: 我？给一个[teenage]女孩提供一次真正的心理咨询，还不带任何别的目的？

lines.en: And to that I say-
lines.zh: 而对此我要说——

lines.en: Of course I have ulterior motives.
lines.zh: 我当然有别的目的。

lines.en: I pretty much always have ulterior motives.
lines.zh: 我几乎任何时候都有别的目的。

lines.en: But at least Tsuneyo is...entertaining to talk to if not anything else.
lines.zh: 不过至少 Tsuneyo……就算别的没有，跟她聊天还挺有意思的。

lines.en: : Your office?
lines.zh: : 你的办公室？

lines.en: : Yeah. You...do realize I’m a teacher here, right?
lines.zh: : 嗯。你……知道我是这儿的老师吧？

lines.en: : I did not initially, no.
lines.zh: : 一开始不知道。

lines.en: : So...you thought I was just some random guy on the roof asking you about your future?
lines.zh: : 所以……你以为我只是天台上随便一个问你未来的家伙？

lines.en: : Is that not common at this[school]?
lines.zh: : 这在这所[school]不常见吗？

lines.en: : Aren’t we like, halfway through the[school] year? You should know what is and isn’t common by now.
lines.zh: : 我们不是[school]年都过了一半了吗？现在你总该知道什么常见什么不常见了。

lines.en: scene tsuneyointro4
: I have only been coming here for several weeks.
lines.zh: : 我来这儿才几周。

lines.en: : I’m afraid I don’t know what is or isn’t normal yet.
lines.zh: : 恐怕我还分不清什么正常什么不正常。

lines.en: : But if you are willing to explain things to me, I will graciously accept your assistance.
lines.zh: : 不过如果你愿意给我讲讲，我会很感激地接受你的帮助。

lines.en: : Wait, you’ve only been coming here for a few weeks? Why?
lines.zh: : 等等，你来这儿才几周？为什么？

lines.en: scene tsuneyointro6
: I was homeschooled until recently.
lines.zh: : 在那之前我一直在家里上学。

lines.en: : But my father has become sick and now I must rely on Ms. Watabe.
lines.zh: : 但父亲病了，现在我只能依靠 Watabe 老师。

lines.en: : Ms. Watabe? So you know Molly?
lines.zh: : Watabe 老师？那你认识 Molly？

lines.en: scene tsuneyointro9
: Molly?
lines.zh: : Molly？

lines.en: : Yeah. She just transferred to my class from Ms. Watabe’s.
lines.zh: : 对。她刚从 Watabe 老师的班转到我们班来。

lines.en: : Irish girl. Red hair. Blue eyes. Hyper.
lines.zh: : 爱尔兰女孩。红头发。蓝眼睛。亢奋。

lines.en: scene tsuneyointro12
: Her...
lines.zh: : 她啊……

lines.en: : That’s a strange reaction, but I’m pretty sure it's warranted.
lines.zh: : 这反应挺怪的，不过我觉得情有可原。

lines.en: : I was under the impression her name was...umm...what was it? Emerald Guardian of the Crystal Forest?
lines.zh: : 我印象中她的名字是……嗯……叫什么来着？水晶森林的翡翠守护者？

lines.en: : That’s her full name. We call her Molly for short.
lines.zh: : 那是她的全名。我们简称她 Molly。

lines.en: scene tsuneyointro9
: Oh. Well then perhaps I wasn’t deceived after all.
lines.zh: : 哦。那看来我也没被骗。

lines.en: Is Tsuneyo really this gullible?
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 真有这么好骗吗？

lines.en: Just how sheltered is she?
lines.zh: 她到底被保护得多好？

lines.en: : Do you have any friends that you hang out with outside of[school], Tsuneyo? I can’t imagine it’s easy making them while being homeschooled.
lines.zh: : 你有在[school]之外一起玩的朋友吗，Tsuneyo？在家上学的话，交朋友不容易吧。

lines.en: scene tsuneyointro5
: I have no friends. Just noodles.
lines.zh: : 我没有朋友。只有面条。

lines.en: I can’t help but bust out into laughter at Tsuneyo’s noodle comment and spend the next several seconds trying to regain my composure...
lines.zh: 听到 Tsuneyo 的面条发言，我忍不住大笑起来，接下来的好几秒都在努力恢复镇定……

lines.en: : Actually, Tsuneyo...Maybe there is hope for you in comedy after all.
lines.zh: : 话说回来，Tsuneyo……也许你在喜剧上还是有希望的。

lines.en: scene tsuneyointro8
: Really? What made you change your mind?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？是什么让你改主意了？

lines.en: : The noodle joke was actually pretty great. Self-deprecating humor is hard to get right, but I think you hit the nail on the head.
lines.zh: : 那个面条笑话其实相当不错。自嘲式幽默很难拿捏，但我觉得你正中靶心。

lines.en: : Noodle joke?
lines.zh: : 面条笑话？

lines.en: : Yeah. No friends, just noodles.
lines.zh: : 对啊。没有朋友，只有面条。

lines.en: scene tsuneyointro7
: That wasn’t a joke...
lines.zh: : 那不是笑话……

lines.en: : Wait, is your life really that sad?
lines.zh: : 等等，你的人生真有这么惨吗？

lines.en: : There’s nothing sad about noodles.
lines.zh: : 面条没什么可惨的。

lines.en: This poor girl.
lines.zh: 这可怜的女孩。

lines.en: : I’ll be your friend, Tsuneyo. That way you won’t need to feel-
lines.zh: : 我来当你的朋友吧，Tsuneyo。那样你就不用觉得——

lines.en: scene tsuneyointro13
: No thank you.
lines.zh: : 不用了，谢谢。

lines.en: : I don’t think you heard me correctly. All I was doing was offering to be your friend. I wasn’t asking you on a date.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你没听清。我只是在提出和你做朋友。我又不是在约你。

lines.en: : Oh, I see.
lines.zh: : 哦，这样啊。

lines.en: : So, does that mean we can-
lines.zh: : 那是不是意味着我们可以——

lines.en: : No thank you.
lines.zh: : 不用了，谢谢。

lines.en: : Mind if I ask why?
lines.zh: : 介意我问为什么吗？

lines.en: scene tsuneyointro4
: I don’t exactly know the reason.
lines.zh: : 我不太清楚原因。

lines.en: : I just know that my father has forbidden me from associating with any male figure that has not received his blessing.
lines.zh: : 我只知道，父亲禁止我和任何没有得到他认可的男性来往。

lines.en: : But we’ve been associating for the entire lunch period.
lines.zh: : 可我们整个午休都在来往啊。

lines.en: Tsuneyo pauses (Which is to be expected at this point) and thinks for a moment before letting out a light sigh and causing her shoulders to droop.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 停顿了一下（到这个地步也在意料之中），想了一会儿，轻轻叹了口气，肩膀垂了下来。

lines.en: : I think this much is fine.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这种程度没关系。

lines.en: : If he asks what I did today, I can just tell him I ran into a customer.
lines.zh: : 如果他问我今天做了什么，我就说遇到了一位顾客。

lines.en: : Do you report everything you do to your father?
lines.zh: : 你把做的每件事都报告给你父亲吗？

lines.en: scene tsuneyointro13
: Of course. Is that not normal?
lines.zh: : 当然。这不正常吗？

lines.en: : Not really by modern standards, no. But I guess it’s different from family to family.
lines.zh: : 按现代标准，确实不太正常。不过我想每个家庭都不一样。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : Do you have any children?
lines.zh: : 你有孩子吗？

lines.en: : I have a [niece]. I guess she’s kind of like a daughter at times, though.
lines.zh: : 我有一个[niece]。不过有时候她也有点像女儿。

lines.en: : You might have seen her around, actually. Her name is Ami. I’m pretty sure she has the longest twintails in the[school].
lines.zh: : 说不定你还见过她。她叫 Ami。我敢肯定她有全[school]最长的双马尾。

lines.en: : Twintails? Are they red?
lines.zh: : 双马尾？是红色的吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. So you do know her then?
lines.zh: : 对。那你还真认识她？

lines.en: : Yes. She complimented me on my skin.
lines.zh: : 是的。她夸过我的皮肤。

lines.en: : No one has ever “flirted” with me before, so it stood out in my mind.
lines.zh: : 从来没有人「调情」过我，所以印象很深。

lines.en: : Sorry to break the news to you, but that’s not exactly what flirting is.
lines.zh: : 抱歉要让你失望了，但那算不上调情。

lines.en: scene tsuneyointro9
: It’s not? But she gave me a compliment based on my appearance.
lines.zh: : 不算吗？可她夸了我的外表。

lines.en: : I already wrote her a rejection letter and everything.
lines.zh: : 我连拒绝信都给她写好了。

lines.en: : Yeah, I think it might be best to just hang onto that for now.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我觉得那封信你最好先留着。

lines.en: : Girls tend to compliment each other's appearances all the time. I think it’s a positive reinforcement thing so they can always feel validated.
lines.zh: : 女孩子之间经常互相夸外表。我觉得这是一种正向强化，好让彼此总能得到认同。

lines.en: scene tsuneyointro13
: Is that so?
lines.zh: : 是这样吗？

lines.en: : Then will you tell Ami I think she has very nice legs?
lines.zh: : 那你能不能替我告诉 Ami，我觉得她的腿很好看？

lines.en: : I think that one’s getting a little closer to flirting territory but sure.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这句话就更接近调情的范畴了，不过行吧。

lines.en: : They were very nice.
lines.zh: : 确实很好看。

lines.en: : She looks soft.
lines.zh: : 她看起来很软。

lines.en: scene tsuneyointro4
: I wonder if she’d let me touch them.
lines.zh: : 我在想她会不会让我摸一摸。

lines.en: : ...I can ask?
lines.zh: : ……我可以帮你问问？

lines.en: scene tsuneyointro13
: Thank you very much. I wasn’t sure if it was rude to ask.
lines.zh: : 非常感谢。我不确定问这个会不会失礼。

lines.en: : Not rude, just a little weird.
lines.zh: : 不失礼，只是有点怪。

lines.en: : I’ll get better in time.
lines.zh: : 我会慢慢进步的。

lines.en: : I sure hope so...
lines.zh: : 我真心希望如此……

lines.en: scene black
Tsuneyo and I chat for another few minutes until the bell rings signaling the end of lunch.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 和我又聊了几分钟，直到铃声响起，宣告午休结束。

lines.en: I hang back to help her gather her things and inform her (To the best of my ability) where her next classroom is.
lines.zh: 我留下来帮她收拾东西，并尽我所能告诉她下一间教室在哪儿。

lines.en: Despite seeming so cool and collected when I saw her at the restaurant, it appears that she’s a bit...aloof when it comes to[school].
lines.zh: 尽管我在餐厅见到她时她看起来那么从容冷静，但在[school]里她似乎有点……摸不着头脑。

lines.en: So the very least I can do is give her a hand when she needs it...
lines.zh: 所以至少我能在她需要的时候帮把手……

lines.en: Which I imagine will be often.
lines.zh: 而我猜她需要的时候会很多。
